Demographic Changes Committee Meets Amit Shah, Plans Field Visits

A high-level committee on demographic changes convened with Union Home Minister Amit Shah. The committee discussed its mandate and outlined plans for field visits to states and Union Territories. These visits aim to gather firsthand, ground-level understanding of demographic shifts across the country.
